stages.headline: The graph of y = f(x) is the set of points (x; f(x)) of the plane, x ∈ D(f).

stages.headline: A curve is the graph of a function if every vertical line meets it at most once; a circle is not a function graph.

stages.headline: From a graph we read values, zeros (meetings with Ox) and intervals of constant sign.
